dict.string: FreeRDP needs Screen Recording permission to display the remote desktop content in a window.
FreeRDP needs Accessibility permission to send keyboard and mouse input to the remote desktop.
FreeRDP needs Input Monitoring permission to capture keyboard input for the remote desktop session.
FreeRDP needs Microphone permission to redirect audio input to the remote desktop.
FreeRDP needs access to folders to support drive redirection (/drive:).
